newsitem.title: UK: C&W up as directors' buying cheers market.
newsitem.headline: C&W up as directors' buying cheers market.

text.p: Shares in Cable and Wireless Plc advanced 18p to 561-1/2p on Friday as the market continued to endorse Thursday's news that four C&W directors bought shares, analysts said.
Richard Brown, chief executive, bought 10,000 shares, Robert Lerwill, finance director, 10,000, Dr Brian Smith, chairman, 18,000 and chief executive, Rod Olsen, 20,000.
Today's news that C&W director Stephen Pettit sold 60,084 shares did nothing to stop the bullish sentiment sparked by the purchases.

"There's an old adage that there are a hundred and one reasons to sell shares - school fees, moving house - but only one reason to buy and that's because you think the price is going up," said Dresdner Kleinwort Benson communications analyst James Dodd.
